Fin9 · Financial Planning · status as of 23 Nov 2026

Financial Planning: from assumptions to advisor-ready plan

A retirement planning system built to advisor standards. It covers a reviewed assumptions register, three ways to bring in client data, a 23-module calculation engine with Monte Carlo and stress testing, an AI layer whose numbers are checked against the engine, and the advisor screens on top. Phase 1 (single-person retirement) has its full calculation and AI core built and QA-tested. The advisor screens are being completed now.

01

Modules we cover

Each module card names the repository it lives in.

Plan engine

OneChat
  • M01–M04 input normalisation, timeline, inflation paths, market return tapes
  • M05–M09 portfolio policy, income, Social Security, expenses and housing, retirement need
  • M10–M14 debt, tax, yearly cash-flow loop with RMDs, surplus waterfall, deficit order
  • M15–M17 deterministic run, Monte Carlo, 5 stress tests
  • M18, M22, M23 lever solvers, blended fix, sensitivity, scenario set
  • M19–M21 report series, health ratios, warnings, 14 triggers, audit hashes

AI insight layer

OneChat
  • Layered prompts: constitution, firm style, run context
  • Section and strategy catalogue; 11 section writers
  • Fragility signals and scenario explanations
  • Number validator: every figure checked against engine output
  • Provider register with per-model capabilities

Intake, gather & reporting

OneChat
  • Collectors: meeting transcript, summary, documents
  • Canonical plan input, merge, validators with hints
  • PII redaction before every model call
  • Plan job runner, billing, webhook with retry
  • Report binding, disclosures, run diff, versioned snapshots

FP server

karax-backend-django
  • Assumptions config v2 → v2.3: advisor overrides, 1-year expiry
  • Intake APIs and status machine (gathering → review → plan)
  • Versioned save, retry, cancel, approve → create plan
  • Plan storage and serving, AI settings
  • FP meeting template API

Advisor app

karax-website
  • Assumptions workspace: search, validation, editing, glide-path and assumption charts
  • FP home, meeting picker, PDF upload, guided manual form
  • Approval and plan-running states
  • Plan report, recommendations, what-if, appendix
  • Advisor checks and client view

US assumptions register

OneChat · shared
  • 8 advisor groups: capital markets, inflation, portfolio, fees, policy, health targets, loan rates, Social Security
  • 12 system groups: simulation, market model, stress, longevity, healthcare, live tax, SS law, housing and more
  • J.P. Morgan capital market assumptions, SSA 2023 life table, PolicyEngine-US tax
